hero.headline: Give to the Light
hero.subheadline: Your generosity fuels the mission — reaching the nations with the light of Christ's Kingdom.

why.headline: Generosity Is an Act of Worship
why.body: At Illumination Global Ministries, giving is not just a transaction — it is an expression of faith and partnership with God's work in the earth. Every gift, large or small, advances the Gospel, supports prayer ministry, and helps us reach communities around the world.
why.scripture: "Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver."

items.title: Global Outreach
items.description: Supporting evangelism and church planting efforts across nations, bringing the Gospel to unreached communities.

items.title: Biblical Teachings
items.description: Producing and distributing sound biblical teaching resources — sermons, studies, and discipleship materials.

items.title: Prayer Ministry
items.description: Sustaining our intercessory prayer network and equipping believers to pray with power and purpose.

items.title: Community Support
items.description: Serving local communities through outreach programs, humanitarian aid, and practical ministry.

ways.headline: Ways to Partner With Us
ways.note: Give securely online with a credit or debit card — one-time or monthly. Every gift makes a difference.

items.title: Online Giving
items.description: Give securely online with your credit or debit card. Choose a one-time gift or become a monthly partner to sustain the mission.

items.title: Bank Transfer
items.description: Contact us directly to receive our bank details for direct transfer or wire giving.

items.title: In Person
items.description: Give during any of our services or ministry gatherings. Every offering is received with gratitude.

cta.headline: Ready to Make a Difference?
cta.body: Whether you give your time, talent, or treasure — your partnership matters. Reach out to us and let's walk this mission together.
